```{r blues}
## find "blue" pipes and fill gaps in data

library(tidyverse)
library(splines)

pipes <- read_csv("Train_update3.csv")
  # every pipe, with a Leaked flag (1 = leaked 2019-2026)
leaks <- read_csv("train.csv")
  # one row per recorded leak, with its repair cost

network <- pipes %>%
  mutate(
    lay_year = year(as.Date(`Lay date`)),
    material_missing = is.na(Material),
    Material_m = replace_na(Material, "wrought iron"),   
    # 8 NA pipes: the project says every iron pipe must be replaced, 
      # so assume iron to be safe
    # all 8 are on water surface, where wrought iron is most common
    
    lay_year_i  = coalesce(lay_year,                      
                # 15 pipes
                median(lay_year[Material_m == "wrought iron"], na.rm = TRUE)),
    is_iron = str_detect(Material_m, "iron"),
    mid_x = (`GPS x1` + `GPS x2`) / 2,
    mid_y = (`GPS y1` + `GPS y2`) / 2
      # use later for clustering/classification
  )

# blue pipes = never leaked (Leaked == 0, so not already replaced by a repair)
# AND not polyurethane to begin with (those never needed replacing)
needs_replacement <- network %>%
  filter(Leaked == 0, Material_m != "polyurethane")

nrow(needs_replacement)   
# should be 27,248, matches Daniel's notebook
```
```{r models}
## fitting 1. leak model (splines + log) and 2. cost model (gamma)


# Likelihood: did the pipe leak in 2019-2026?
# logistic regression (binomial) because the outcome is yes/no.
leak_fit <- glm(
  Leaked ~ Material_m + Surface + ns(lay_year_i, 4) + log(Length),
  family = binomial,
  data = filter(network, Material_m != "polyurethane")
)

# Where:
# Leaked: whether the pipe actually leaked in 2019–2026 (1 = yes, 0 = no); the model predicts the probability of Leaked = 1
# Material_m: the pipe’s original material, with the 8 missing values filled in as wrought iron
# Surface: what the pipe runs under (grassland, farmland, swamp, water, road, or structure)
# lay_year_i: the year the pipe was laid, with the 15 missing years filled in using the median for wrought iron
# ns(lay_year_i, 4): lay year turned into a flexible curve so leak chance can rise and fall with age, uses spline with df = 4
# log(Length): the log of the pipe’s length in metres, so extra length matters less for long pipes

# cost data: one row per leak, joined to pipe features 
sev <- leaks %>%
  inner_join(select(network, `Pipe ID`, Material_m, Surface, Length), by = "Pipe ID")
# head(sev)

# cost given a leak (gamma model)
cost_fit <- glm(
  Cost ~ Surface + Material_m + log(Length),
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = sev
)
 summary(cost_fit)
```

```{r priority}
## creating a priority dataset based on expected cost if not fixed

# expected loss = P(leak) * cost if leak
priority <- needs_replacement %>%
  mutate(
    p_leak_8yr = predict(leak_fit, newdata = pick(everything()), type = "response"),
      # probability the pipe leaked over the 8-year window (2019-2026)
    
    p_leak_annual = 1 - (1 - p_leak_8yr)^(1/8),
      # geometric dist: Y ~ geom(p)
    
    cost_if_leak = predict(cost_fit, newdata = pick(everything()), type = "response"),
    exp_annual_loss = p_leak_annual * cost_if_leak,
        # expected yearly cost if left unreplaced

    loss_per_metre  = exp_annual_loss / Length
  )
head(priority)

# write_csv(priority, "priority_all.csv")
```



```{r}
## priority datasets (by iron)

# only iron pipes are mandated! 
priority_iron <- priority %>%
  filter(is_iron)

# rank by expected loss per meter
iron_rank <- priority_iron %>%
  group_by(Material_m) |>
  summarise(loss_per_m = sum(exp_annual_loss) / sum(Length)) |>
  mutate(type_rank = min_rank(desc(loss_per_m)))   
# 1 = worst alloy

# sort by expected annual loss
priority_iron <- priority_iron %>%
  left_join(select(iron_rank, Material_m, type_rank), by = "Material_m") %>%
  arrange(desc(exp_annual_loss)) %>%
  mutate(priority_rank = row_number()) %>%
  select(priority_rank, 
         `Pipe ID`, 
         iron_type = Material_m, 
         type_rank, 
         Surface, 
         Length,
         p_leak_annual, 
         cost_if_leak, 
         exp_annual_loss, 
         loss_per_metre, 
         mid_x, 
         mid_y, 
         material_missing)

head(priority_iron)

# write_csv(priority_iron, "priority_iron.csv")
```


```{r}
## checking based on loss (total expected yearly loss, sorted by surface),
  # sanity check?
priority_iron %>%
  group_by(Surface) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), avg_loss = mean(exp_annual_loss), total_loss = sum(exp_annual_loss)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_loss))
```
